# Googleforms

Google Forms is a survey administration software that allows users to create and share online forms and surveys.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/googleforms/.

## Actions

- **Batch Update Form**: Applies a batch of update operations to a Google Form in a single atomic transaction.
- **Create a Google Form**: Creates a new Google Form with the specified title.
- **Get form response** (read-only): Retrieves a single form response by its unique response ID.
- **Get Google Form** (read-only): Retrieves the complete structure and metadata of a Google Form.
- **List Form Watches** (read-only): Lists all watches owned by the calling project for a specific Google Form.
- **List Google Form Responses** (read-only): Lists all responses submitted to a Google Form with optional filtering and pagination.
- **Set Form Publish Settings**: Updates the publishing settings of a Google Form, controlling whether the form is published (visible to others) and whether it accepts…
